disclosures.text: A device for attachment to a surface with a suction cup.
The device includes a measuring device for measuring the suction force.
A device for attachment to a surface with a suction cup, comprising a measuring device for measuring the suction force.
The device includes a display for indicating the suction force.
The measuring device and/or the display is electronic.
The device includes a power supply and/or is connectable to a power supply.
The device includes a housing, wherein the housing is smaller than the suction cup.
The device includes an actuating device for increasing the suction force.
The device includes a resilient element.
The resilient element is exchangeable.
The resilient element is a conical spring.
The resilient element presses against the actuating device, stored in a sleeve, counter to the suction force of the suction cup.
A coil is arranged in both the actuating device and the sleeve holding it, allowing measurement of the displacement of the actuating device relative to the sleeve.
The device includes a pretensioning lever that fixes the actuating device against the force of the resilient element.
The measuring device operates mechanically.
The position of the suction plate relative to other fixed components is determined by markings.
The measuring device uses a system of coils or other electronic elements.
The measuring device measures a change in the electric field between moving and stationary parts.
The display is mechanical-optical.
The display uses position markings to indicate the working position of the suction plate.
The display includes warning markings indicating a change in suction force.
The device has an acoustic and/or optical display.
The device has a transmission function to send the holding force signal to a receiver.
The receiver for the holding force signal is the attached device.
Measured suction force values are converted into a stepless display by an electronic evaluation unit.
The display shows suction force in percentage or as a green-red bar.
The device generates changing acoustic signals.
The power supply is a battery or rechargeable battery housed in the device.
The device is equipped with a solar module for power supply.
The power supply is an external power source.
The power supply is the device attached to the holder.
The suction cup has a tab to facilitate removal from the surface.
The actuating device is an actuating button.
The resilient element is a coil spring.
The effective portion of the spring is adjustable to set spring strength and suction force.
The actuating button also serves as the measuring device.
Position markings are applied to the actuating button.
The actuating button is also the holding element for the compression spring.
The actuating button is mounted in a precise guide within the suction cup housing.
Microswitches query the position of the actuating button.
The actuating button has rings, recesses, or elevations of varying depths.
The pretensioning lever holds the actuating device completely within its sleeve.
The position of the actuating button corresponds to the rest position of the suction cup.
The suction cup membrane is in a fully extended state when the pretensioning lever is engaged.
The total travel of the actuating button in the sleeve is approximately 2 mm to 2.5 mm.
A light-emitting diode (LED) indicates green for 0 mm to 0.6 mm travel.
A light-emitting diode (LED) indicates yellow for 0.6 mm to 1.1 mm travel.
A light-emitting diode (LED) indicates red for travel beyond 1.1 mm.
